name: Emerald Route
palette: Background #F8FAF5; primary deep emerald #145C3F; accent chartreuse #D9F269; text #18271F; white cards #FFFFFF
direction: Search-first spatial layout. Wide clean white header. Oversized left aligned headline 'Your next chapter. Your way.' with emerald word emphasis. Broad search console below headline with labeled Course, City and Budget fields, primary 'Find colleges'. On right a sophisticated small isometric 3D white-and-green campus island with gently swaying tree leaves, restrained floating route line, floating useful label 'Explore your options', no cartoon faces. Below console three intent cards 'Search colleges', 'Match my marks', 'Help me choose'. College cards with landscape campus thumbnail and orderly fee, location, placement-year rows; a compare checkbox and visibly outlined saved state. Lower guided comparison band and news grid. Organic route shapes only in illustration, UI grid disciplined.
motion: Leaves sway 6s; route draws once; card hover rises 3px.
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE extremely polished high-resolution portrait UI design presentation board for NSEDU, an Indian college discovery platform, theme selection only. A long FULL landing page dominates 78% width, flat straight-on browser view, and a 22% right annotation rail with large readable theme labeling, exact hex swatches, fonts, card anatomy, and motion proposal inset. Aim 2160x2880 resolution or similar portrait. Make image useful for choosing a design, professionally art directed, realistic legible UI typography, clear generous spacing. DO NOT shrink text into microscopic paragraphs; concise meaningful sections and strong headings. Main landing contains: attractive functional header NSEDU / Colleges / Courses / Compare / Guidance / Updates / Log in / Create account; a hero with useful search or guidance entry; course discovery; marks-budget-city finder; college cards; compare preview; AI career guide with a real example question; current education articles with 'Demo content' and dates clearly shown; a save-shortlist signup CTA; tidy light footer with About, Help, Privacy. Data uses fictional 'Northfield Institute', 'Meadow University', 'Central Design College' and labels 'Illustrative data'; sample fees labeled Annual tuition and placement data labeled year/data pending; no fake claims of verified reviews, millions users, guaranteed admissions or live actual results. One primary CTA per section. Light page backgrounds covering over80% page, excellent dark-text contrast, absolutely NO BLUE/navy/cyan, no terracotta-pistachio theme. UI icons consistent thin lines, not random emoji. Images depict diverse Indian young adults respectfully, natural confidence. Motion is a proposed static two-state small inset, not actual animation. Annotation rail is OUTSIDE the website, label concept number/name at top, palette role + code, chosen font families (indicative visual rendering), card radius and anatomy, hover/selected state, motion label. Also a small mobile hero crop inset at bottom rail with no overlap. Do not write competitors' names anywhere on board; extract usability patterns but original branding/layout. Do not create6 tiny thumbnails in one image.

fonts: DM Serif Display headings, Plus Jakarta Sans body

name: Plum Compass
palette: Background #FCF9FF; primary aubergine #54245F; accent coral #F17864; soft lilac #EEDFF4; text #29202D; white #FFFFFF
